scope: Raw Wan-Animate-2 distilled Hand2Dex case-1 baseline
summary: The pinned raw baseline preserves motion and target appearance but fails object and temporal gates, so it is rejected for embodiment-transfer acceptance.
evidence: The two-A800, 81-frame, 10-step, guidance-1.0 distilled run completed with a hashed raw result.
Frozen local evaluator scores were motion 0.807974, target identity 0.992787, object consistency 0.211167, and temporal consistency 0.314752.
The 0.75 object and temporal gates failed; no postprocessing result is substituted into the raw-model row.
lessons: High target identity and source-motion similarity do not imply object-preserving, temporally coherent embodiment transfer.
The complete all-gates pass rate must remain the primary endpoint.
limitations: This is one public case and one seed.
Proxy metrics do not validate 3-D contact, force, or physical execution.
next_actions: Finish the other two frozen seed-42 cases; stop the three-seed expansion if the complete case-level smoke remains 0/3.
